$comment: Maps a benchmark name as a MODEL CARD writes it to the constituent id a
furnisher reports, so W-EV-DIV-07 can compare a self-reported score against
an independently measured one for the SAME thing.
In pack data, not code (addendum v0.1 A3): the mapping tracks naming
conventions in the wild and must move without a release.
THE RISK THIS TABLE CARRIES. A wrong match fabricates a divergence -- the
worst failure available to DIV-07, because the finding it produces looks
exactly like the finding that matters. So: exact normalised match only, no
fuzzy matching, no substring, no edit distance. An unmatched reported score
produces NO DIV-07 finding and is recorded as unmatched. Silence on an
Coverage is expected to be low and that is measured, not assumed: across 49
cards only 8% name any raidex constituent (studies/card-eval-reporting-
2026-08). Cards report capability; this furnisher measures responsible-AI
properties. The disjoint case is W-EV-COR-09's, not this rule's.
